title: Georgia court revives tenants' claims after mistaken 2022 apartment raid and detention
summary_full: The Georgia Court of Appeals has delivered a significant ruling regarding tenant safety rights in a case involving an off-duty police officer and residents of Roswell Creek Apartments. The court has reinstated accusations of assault and false imprisonment against the property owner, stemming from the officer's actions. This landmark decision may pave the way for heightened accountability in property management concerning tenant security.
